# JointJS Community 4.3.4

Copyright client IO and the JointJS contributors. Distributed under MPL-2.0;
see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The application uses the open-source Community package.
No JointJS+ commercial components are included.

This ESM bundle is generated from the unchanged, pinned `@joint/core@4.3.4`
package by `pnpm run vendor:joint`. The preferred upstream source is available
in the [exact npm source archive](https://registry.npmjs.org/@joint/core/-/core-4.3.4.tgz)
and the [upstream repository](https://github.com/clientIO/joint).
The application wrapper and custom editor are separate GTM Growth code.

The bundle retains included third-party license comments. Dependency upgrades
must regenerate this directory and run the strict-CSP Campaign Studio browser QA.
